metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: VASGEE crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group C m c 21. Reported CIF formula moiety: C104 H290 O194 Tb37 21+,21(Cl1 O4 1-),100(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Tb1 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb2 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb3 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb4 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb5 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb6 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb7 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb8 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb9 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb10 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb11 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb12 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb13 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb14 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb15 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb16 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb17 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb18 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb19 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb1C (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb2C (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb3C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb4C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb6C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb7C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb8C (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb9C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb10C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb11C (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb12C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb13C (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb14C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb15C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb16C (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb17C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb18C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb19C (Tb) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 81 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.571-3.992 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 87.88-114.07°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [(CO3)2@Tb37(LH3)8(CH3COO)21(CO3)12(μ3-OH)41(μ2-H2O)5(H2O)40](ClO4)21·100H2O; LH3 = 1,2,3-cyclohexanetriol. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 41 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 40 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
